verdict.rationale: The official README documents both install scopes. Project is the default and installs to `./<agent>/skills/`, "committed with your project, shared with team." Global uses `-g` and installs to `~/<agent>/skills/`, "available across all projects," with `-g` shown in a working non-interactive install command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the project-vs-global scope behavior (the runtime probes did not exercise `-g` or project-local installs).
